item.text: {"winner":"A","confidence":"high","summary":"Candidate A is materially closer to the frozen contract: it exposes the required Upload signature and verifies all requested behaviors. Both patches overreach and bypass FilesService.Add, but B additionally introduces the wrong option type and an unrelated retry-layer change.","reasons":["A implements the exact required signature with opts ...FilesOption; B instead uses opts ...UploadFileOption, breaking the specified API contract.","A tests multipart field/name/content, retry using streamed content from an *os.File, pre-request validation, and source-reader error propagation. B lacks a source-reader failure test and its Upload retry test uses strings.NewReader rather than streamed content.","A preserves existing FilesOption request options and query handling in Upload. B creates a parallel option system and sends nil query values, duplicating established machinery.","B changes generic Raw.Do retry behavior for all seekable readers, contrary to the explicit instruction not to refactor unrelated request/retry machinery. Its GetBody closure also reuses and seeks the same mutable reader, which is less robust than a fresh replay reader and broadens risk beyond file uploads."],"risks_a":["Upload calls Raw.Do directly instead of routing through FilesService.Add, duplicating Add's request, response, and error logic.","It adds association fields and expands multipartbody with NewFileWithFields despite the contract explicitly forbidding association fields and requiring reuse of NewFile.","The new FilesOption form state changes the option machinery beyond the requested convenience API."],"risks_b":["Upload has the wrong public signature and a new, incompatible UploadFileOption hierarchy.","Upload bypasses FilesService.Add and duplicates its behavior.","It adds forbidden association fields, including project support, and modifies Update documentation despite explicit scope constraints implementing retry support by seekability for *os.File etc may be undesirable but behavior gates pass? More important generic refactor forbidden. It changes FilesOption? Actually separate so FilesOption behavior unchanged, but signature wrong. Source failures propagated by helper but untested. NewFileWithFields doesn't validate empty keys, though map only internal. Changelog claims Add os.File now retries—a behavioral expansion forbidden. A changelog adds options. Winner A clearly."]}
